about_the_game:
GAME WORLD

MOULD takes place in an alternate industrial version of the Soviet Union in the late 1940s. World War II never happened, construction projects are booming across the USSR, and scientists are working hard to create steel builders for a bright future. At one of the mining enterprises, miners come across something unimaginable, and humanity is faced with a deadly threat. A parasite has escaped from the depths — a creature capable of subjugating living organisms, gradually devouring them from within. As it reproduces, it begins to change the environment, making it more comfortable for itself but unbearable for the planet's inhabitants.

GAMEPLAY DESCRIPTION

The hero will face enemies that are stronger than him. To effectively destroy the infection, he can use a variety of deadly traps. Enemies are divided into classes, and each class has its own characteristics. Their parameters depend on the alarm level of the central control system captured by the parasite. The longer the hero fights in the arena, the more information he reveals about himself. After clearing the arena, you will have a chance to choose an artifact that can either help the hero or aggravate the situation.

GAME FEATURES

—The environment conveys the atmosphere of a once-prosperous world now in decline—

—A wide selection of weapons to suit every taste: whether it's a heavy hammer, a precision rifle, or a flamethrower that burns anyone who dares to stand in your way—

—Dynamic difficulty that affects the strength and number of enemies—

—Procedural destructibility that allows you to smash enemies to pieces—

short_description: MOULD is an action shooter that tells the story of an unfulfilled Soviet dream. The Earth is gradually becoming uninhabitable, humanity is no longer there, and its place is taken by a monstrous life form capable of surviving in the planet's new conditions.
